findings.title: Too little of the diff was examined to support PASS
findings.description: The diff was 199225 characters (review.large_diff_chars is 100000) and the model made 2 successful tool call(s); review.min_tool_calls_large_diff is 3. The verdict rests mostly on the diff text, not on the code behind it. The model's own verdict was PASS.

findings.title: Native installer replaces the bash script path cleanly
findings.description: The `guideScript.ts` shell-out is gone. `setup-ide.ts` now calls `installIde` in-process for the root and for each worktree. The worktree loop in `installWorktrees` records an exit-1 install, keeps going, and lets any other exception propagate. That matches `installIde`'s own split in `installer.ts:90-97`, where `InstallAbort` and filesystem errors become exit 1 and everything else is rethrown. I found no leftover references to the deleted symbols (`readManifest`, `propagateToWorktrees`, `guideScript`, `propagateDirs`) in the CLI package. The `AGENT_SKILLS_DIR` and `GENERATED_MARKER` exports are still used by `commandInstaller.ts` and `targets/*.ts`, so removing the descriptor fields left no dead exports.

findings.title: Dry-run sandbox is cleaned up on every path and checks the real project
findings.description: `dryRunInstall` removes the sandbox in a `finally` block, so an abort or throw still cleans up, and `flags.test.ts` covers the abort case. Lint detection still reads from `projectRoot` while writes go to the sandbox, so `--dry-run --write-lint` previews against the real project. `LINT_WRITE_PATHS` in `paths.ts` keeps the sandbox copy list in step with the files `lint.ts` can write.

findings.title: The `getApplyTo` (#40) and `replaceBlock` (#38) fixes are intentional and tested
findings.description: Both functions now deviate from the bash behaviour on purpose. `getApplyTo` returns `**` once instead of `**\n**`. `replaceBlock` keeps a missing final newline (`managedSection.ts:123-128`). The unit tests and snapshots were updated to match, and the doc comments say why. The `replaceBlock` slice is only applied when the original is non-empty and lacks a trailing newline, so it never strips a newline that was in the input. The copilot manifest CRCs changed in the snapshots as a direct result, which is consistent.

findings.title: `worktreePropagation.ts` no longer propagates anything
findings.description: The file now holds only `propagationTargets`, and its caller `installWorktrees` lives in `setup-ide.ts`. The "propagation" name no longer matches what the code does. Consider folding `propagationTargets` into `setup-ide.ts` or renaming the module. This is cosmetic and doesn't block anything.

findings.title: Minor test and typing polish
findings.description: There is a stray double blank line before `describe('cf setup-ide'`. The tests assert what cf passes to `installIde` and what it does with the result, and the installer's own behaviour is covered under `tests/ideInstall`. That split keeps each layer's tests about its own behaviour. Coverage for `lint.ts` (python, dart, typescript, csharp depth, `missingRequirements`) and `rulesExclude` is reasonable. The `lint.ts` python branch that builds `extendSelect` with `split/join/replaceAll` is roundabout. It is a port, so a one-line `join(', ')` would be a safe simplification.
